inputs.title: ALMA 2022.A.00026.S · band 6 continuum image of Betelgeuse, August 2023
inputs.acquisition: The member's continuum image member.uid___A001_X360d_Xae.Betelgeuse_sci.spw25_27_29_31.cont.regcal.I.pbcor.fits, made with the same calibration as the line cube, downloaded whole from the archive and cut by tools/objects/source-authoring/betelgeuse-shell/reduce-alma-sio.mts to a box 300 mas either way of the phase centre, values unchanged. It is the only product of the observation that shows where the star is.
inputs.license: ALMA data are public under the ALMA data access policy; retain the ALMA credit line.

inputs.title: ALMA 2022.A.00026.S · SiO v=0 J=5-4 cube of Betelgeuse, August 2023
inputs.acquisition: Cut out of the archive's own pipeline cube member.uid___A001_X360d_Xae.Betelgeuse_sci.spw27.cube.regcal.I.pbcor.fits through its SODA service, on the circle about the observation's phase centre that the origin URL requests. tools/objects/source-authoring/betelgeuse-shell/reduce-alma-sio.mts keeps the channels within 32 km/s of 8 km/s LSRK in a box 300 mas either way of the phase centre, and subtracts from each pixel the median of the 1738 channels more than 120 km/s from the line. The pipeline removes the continuum before imaging, so that median is only its residual. The archive product is 72 GB; this is the part of it that carries the line around this star.
inputs.license: ALMA data are public under the ALMA data access policy; retain the ALMA credit line.

inputs.title: VLTI/MATISSE 4 µm reconstruction, February 2020, convolved to the 4 mas beam
inputs.credit: Reconstruction by this repository with SQUEEZE 3.0 (F. Baron, GPL-3.0) from ESO/VLTI/MATISSE calibrated visibilities via the JMMC OiDB; observations from Drevon et al. (2024)
inputs.acquisition: The same bytes Betelgeuse’s own package ships and pins, copied here so this package accounts for every byte it reads. Only the light outside the published disc is used; the disc itself is the star’s drawn sphere.
inputs.license: Reconstruction released by this repository under its own licence; the MATISSE visibilities are ESO archive data under the ESO data access policy.
